{{Quote|You see, the quality ratings for Black Fifteen had nothing to do with the engineering staff or the foremen and everything to do with the Yevethan guildsmen. They've got the gift of understanding how a thing is put together practically on a first glance. Then they draw it from memory the next day, and by the third they've figured out everything that's wrong about it and started making you a better one.|[[Davith Sconn]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="DFC2">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
'''Black Fifteen''' was the code-designation of a [[Type II Orbital Repair Yard]] assigned to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]] and placed in orbit above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'zoth]] in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]]. The [[Shipyard/Legends|facility]] was renowned as the finest conscript facility in the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]], in which the Koornacht Cluster lay; this was due to the work of the native [[Yevetha]], who were adept at the construction and modification of space [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. The yard was [[Yevethan Uprising|taken over]] by the Yevetha in 4 ABY, shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and the facility's staff and [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were captured.

==History==
Built after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] subjugation of N'zoth, Black-15 was attached to the planetary occupation force under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jian Paret]], and manned by a Yevethan work force that outnumbered their Imperial overseers nine to one.<ref name="DFC1" /> As with all Type II yards, the facility possessed nine shipways arranged in a massive square formation.<ref name="DFC1" /> It was not capable of constructing [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]], but it was possible to dock these massive ships at some of the facility's outward berths, and the [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Intimidator'']] was moored here after she was transferred to Koornacht from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] for the final stages of her fitting-out.<ref name="DFC1" /> Black-15 was primarily designated for the construction and fitting-out of new warships, as opposed to repair operations. However, the reputation of the Yevethan technicians was such<ref name="DFC2" /> that [[Captain/Legends|captains]] in the local [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Group]] who needed repairs done on their ships eagerly seized any available docking slots, and by the time N'zoth was lost to the Empire, eight months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], a sizable proportion of the work being done at Black-15 involved the rebuilding and reconstruction of old or damaged ships.<ref name="DFC1" /> At this point, however, the guardship [[Harridan (starship)|''Harridan'']] was withdrawn to serve at the front, and Commander Paret received his orders to pull out of the system.<ref name="DFC1" /> Seizing the moment, the Yevethan underground, led by [[Nil Spaar]], launched a coup and killed or enslaved the remaining Imperial forces.<ref name="DFC1" /> They seized the warships present and captured the shipyards, and, forming a government known as the [[Duskhan League]], put Black-15 to use upgrading and maintaining the captured ships of the Black Fleet, and constructing new warships to the old Imperial designs.<ref name="DFC1" />
